09 / BEFORE WE BEGIN

Questions worth asking.

Is LeakEvidence operating software?+

This is a research-stage website and a working, isolated synthetic demo. Production integrations, local detection performance, customer demand and accepted pricing have not been demonstrated.

What data does an evaluation need?+

A named data owner should review AMI licensing, flow/pressure availability, billing quality and GIS boundaries. Real records require procurement, legal and data-sharing permission before use.

How would you establish value?+

Blind-rank known repaired leaks and representative false alerts in one district against retrospective utility triage. Pre-register precision at an agreed crew-visit budget, avoided non-leak visits and verification cost.

Who owns field decisions?+

The utility sponsor, operations director and crew supervisor. LeakEvidence supplies proposed read-only decision support; there are no physical controls, dispatch or automated writeback.

Can we test one module first?+

Yes. The five modules are separate quotation hypotheses. A first paid evaluation should select one module and a bounded district workflow.

Why are there no testimonials?+

No customer outcomes or approvals have been supplied. The site shows inspectable synthetic evidence and a pilot scorecard instead of fabricated customer proof.
